editorial:
Imagine you are on a dream vacation in a beautiful Mediterranean house, trying to forget a bad memory. That is exactly where you find Emily and Robert. She is a famous actress and he is a doctor. Everything feels perfect until a blood-covered girl shows up at their door, crying about her boyfriend dying in a hiking accident. Robert wants to be the hero and help her, but you will quickly notice that this girl is not as innocent as she seems. She starts acting strange and tries to get between the couple, making you wonder if she is actually a danger to Emily.

The acting is solid and the tension builds up in a way that keeps you guessing. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the mystery makes up for it. You will love the twisty nature of the story if you enjoy movies where you cannot trust anyone. If you want to see the scenery look its best, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV. It is a great pick for a rainy night when you want something suspenseful but not too heavy.
endingExplained: You find out that the young girl was not a random stranger at all. She was actually working with Robert to gaslight Emily and make her feel like she was losing her mind. Robert wanted to control Emily completely. In the end, the truth comes out during a violent clash. Emily manages to fight back against her husband and the girl, finally escaping the trap they set for her to save her own life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers with a big twist.
